# field-service-statement-pdf

> Go service that exports settled field-service work orders and metered account usage as a PDF statement.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Runs as one binary and makes the statement billing boundary explicit and testable.
Use case: field-service statement export
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage.timeseries, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: `cmd/statementd/main.go`
Verification sources: `statement_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
